study_identification_part.si4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states aims to use normative modeling on task-fMRI to establish a healthy reference and quantify individualized deviations in patients with MDD, BD, and SZ, embedding deviations into emotional networks and linking them to affective symptoms. These objectives and the purpose of normative modeling are explicitly described in the abstract and methods.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We used normative modeling to establish a reference for functional activation... derived from a large dataset of healthy individuals (n = 409) and used to evaluate individualized functional alterations... in patients with MDD, BD, and SZ. The functional deviations were mapped to emotional networks ... and used to predict affective symptoms."; "we aimed to investigate cross-scale neural dysfunctions related to affective symptoms ... By utilizing 2 task-fMRI datasets and a normative modeling framework, robust and individualized functional deviations ... were first identified... and assessed the associations with affective symptoms dimension."
cm1_research_objectives.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md, ABSTRACT; Methods – overall aim paragraph

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The healthy reference cohort (HCtrain) is described with inclusion (Han Chinese, 18–43 years, right-handed) and exclusion criteria (no neurological/psychiatric disease per DSM-IV, no LOC >5 min, not pregnant/lactating, MRI contraindications, etc.). Final sample sizes are reported. Image quality/data completeness procedures are referenced and some preprocessing/QC steps are specified (e.g., motion realignment, exclusion of first 4 volumes), but explicit quantitative image quality thresholds and exclusion counts due to QC are not detailed.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "The participants ... healthy dataset included 409 healthy controls (HCtrain)... All participants were included if they: 1) were Chinese of Han ancestry; 2) age 18 to 43; 3) right-handed... The healthy samples were excluded if they: 1) had current or history of neurological or psychiatric disease... 2) had a history of loss of consciousness >5 min; 3) pregnant or lactating... 4) had contraindications to MRI scanning."; "See the Supplement for additional criteria ... and quality-control details."

Multi-site handling is not applicable for training since HCtrain comes from a single site.
